Snapshot: candidate e1d097359f260a694f80214387f5be58a74bd566; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 6b0f65393a10e7840c6d141c6d6569e70b13b2c7. Opening and closing gates both exited 0: 2304 candidate objects, 2296 accepted objects remain, and all four added stroke files are raw-identical. The 2304 actual count exceeds the prospective 2300 bookkeeping count by the noted four stroke objects.
Scope: All requested windows returned completely with exit code 0: current RU guidance and three rubrics; four complete EN/RU primary lessons; 15 complete context EN/RU pairs; five unchanged linked EN/RU bodies; four English-only comparison bodies; all 21 KANJIDIC2 records, radical records and header, 60 JMdict entries and four KanjiPedia entries; all 398 current typed kanji metadata rows; 12 proposals, four adjudications, four clarifications, four outside-limit records and both exact navigation diffs. Pool review was metadata/title-level, as assigned. No window failed or was unread.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, strokes, classical keys/numbers, examples, word senses, mnemonic labelling and attributed origin claims in 才/支/放/断 agree with the frozen source and bound official evidence. The age counter is correctly qualified as primarily 歳, with 才 an accepted alternative; 支払う is treated as ateji; 放 senses and the 断る/断つ/判断 qualifications are bounded accurately.
C2 CLEAN: Both existing-file edits are exact single-glyph link wrappers only; all targets are relative and exist. New lesson links resolve only to current RU pages; absent Russian comparison words remain plain Japanese text. All 12 directed options are separately safe against the displayed current titles for introductory/source-core comparison only; see N dispositions. No reverse or transitive guard is inferred. Author L/A records are supported within their stated bounds; outside observations remain limits, not new guards.
C3 CLEAN: The four lessons and navigation wrappers are clear, readable Russian for the stated scope; no confirmed correctable naturalness or comprehension defect found. Titles are serviceable concise glosses, with their additional nuances explained in the bodies.
N001才→手 S-intro: «талант; способности» vs «рука»; JMdict's hand/worker/help/means senses do not make 手 a talent answer. Shared 手 radical is explicitly distinguished.
N002才→木 S-intro: tree/wood does not answer talent/ability; the contrasting strokes are accurately described.
N003才→千 S-intro: thousand has no talent/ability sense; the crossing/hook distinction is accurate.
N004支→友 S-intro: «поддержка; ответвление» vs «друг»; a friend may help, but that relationship is not the kanji gloss. Shared 又-like lower strokes are explicitly a shape comparison.
N005支→父 S-intro: «отец» is not support/branch; the lower-shape comparison and differing tops are accurate.
N006支→文 S-intro: «предложение; письменный текст» is not support/branch; the shared crossing appearance is not semantic.
N007放→方 S-intro: direction/way/person is not release/emit; 方 is a real component and has a ホウ reading contact, both disclosed, not a shared meaning.
N008放→旅 S-intro: journey/travel is not release/emit; shared 方 component is clearly distinguished from 放's 攵.
N009放→教 S-intro: teach/instruct is not release/emit; shared 攵 radical does not imply shared meaning.
N010断→新 S-intro: new/fresh is not sever/refuse/decide; shared 斤 is accurately identified.
N011断→料 S-intro: materials/fee is not sever/refuse/decide; shared 米 and differing right part are accurately noted.
N012断→近 S-intro: near/close is not sever/refuse/decide; shared 斤 within distinct whole shapes is accurately described.
L001才 SUPPORTED: source facts, readings, meanings and attributed KanjiPedia account are accurately bounded; age and 才能/天才 distinctions are supported.
L002支 SUPPORTED: source facts and branching/support senses are supported; 支払う/支度 treatment and linked pages are accurate.
L003放 SUPPORTED: source facts, attributed 形声 explanation, release/emission senses and contrasts with 話す/離れる are supported.
L004断 SUPPORTED: source facts and attributed old-form account are supported; refusal, cutting and judgment are distinguished.
A001 SOURCE-BOUNDED: 才/歳 counter and talent-vs-genius explanation are supported without frequency claims.
A002 SOURCE-BOUNDED: 支払う ateji and kana-usual つかえる distinctions are supported.
A003 SOURCE-BOUNDED: 放つ senses, はなす homophone, 放れる/離れる distinction and out-of-table こく note are supported.
A004 SOURCE-BOUNDED: 断る secondary senses, 断つ/絶つ spelling and judgment distinction are supported.
NAV01 words/支度.md: NAV-ONLY; exact wrapper [支](../kanji/支.md), target exists; all other visible prose and metadata unchanged.
NAV02 words/放送.md: NAV-ONLY; exact wrapper [放](../kanji/放.md), target exists; all other visible prose and metadata unchanged.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT-ONLY; age/year and 力 ability/readings are flagged, not added as guards. O002 LIMIT-ONLY; 仕 forms/readings, 助 support, 度 partner and 止 reading are flagged. O003 LIMIT-ONLY; 発 release/はなつ, 話 homophone, 送 partner and 報 reading are flagged. O004 LIMIT-ONLY; 切/否 overlap, 判 partner, 定 reading and 立/発 homophones are flagged. None is a distractor in these directions; no new exclusion inferred.
Findings: none
Optional: none.
Limits: No tests/builds, runtime quiz/UI, wider corpus bodies or native-speaker study performed; prohibited/not part of this bounded review. The 398-row pool was read as typed metadata, not all lesson bodies. No web pages consulted.
